summary: Wrote a five-phase implementation plan for region-aware task-ref-ok marker resolution in the write-time gate. The research report's design (region-aware over a reconstructed post-edit file, depth-counting parser, Write path untouched, graceful degradation) is adopted substantially unchanged. Planning added one finding the report did not anticipate: five source-store test files currently parse to eof_depth > 0 -- two from redundant nested begins, three because prose that mentions the literal token is itself parsed as a marker -- so the depth-counter tightening would turn the repo-wide lint red. The plan therefore sequences a tree-wide marker-hygiene phase ahead of the parser change, and adds a standing balance diagnostic.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: marker hygiene, shared depth-counting parser plus new library suite, hook Edit-path merge with the six dispatch-named cases, lint diagnostic plus documented semantics, redeploy and full gate verification.
